exercises.name: Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Lie with eyes under the bar, feet flat. Squeeze shoulder blades together. Lower the bar to mid-chest under control, then press up and slightly back.
exercises.safety_tips: Use a spotter or safety pins. Keep wrists stacked over elbows. Stop if you feel shoulder pain.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Lie flat with dumbbells over the chest. Lower them to the sides of the chest with elbows about 45° from the body, then press up.
exercises.safety_tips: Kick the dumbbells up from your thighs to start; lower them back to the thighs to finish.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
exercises.instructions: Set the seat so handles line up with mid-chest. Press forward without locking elbows hard, return slowly until you feel a stretch.
exercises.safety_tips: Keep your back against the pad. Adjust the seat before loading heavy.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.instructions: Set the bench to 30–45°. Start with dumbbells over the chest, lower them to the sides of the upper chest, then press up and slightly in.
exercises.safety_tips: Choose a weight you can get into position safely. Lower dumbbells to your thighs before sitting up.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Press
exercises.instructions: Bench at 30–45°. Lower the bar to the upper chest under control, then press up.
exercises.safety_tips: Use safety pins or a spotter. Keep shoulder blades pulled back.

exercises.name: Incline Machine Press
exercises.instructions: Set the seat so handles start around upper-chest height. Press up and forward, return slowly.
exercises.safety_tips: Keep your back against the pad.

exercises.name: Seated Shoulder Press
exercises.instructions: Sit with back supported. Press dumbbells from shoulder height to overhead, then lower to ear level.
exercises.safety_tips: Do not arch the lower back. Use a machine if overhead pressing feels uncomfortable.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.instructions: Raise dumbbells (or a cable) out to the side to shoulder height with slightly bent elbows. Lower slowly.
exercises.safety_tips: Light weights work best. Stop at shoulder height; do not shrug.

exercises.name: Rope Triceps Pushdown
exercises.instructions: Stand at a high pulley holding a rope. Keep elbows pinned at your sides and push down, spreading the rope at the bottom.
exercises.safety_tips: Only the forearms should move.

exercises.name: Cable Triceps Extension
exercises.instructions: Face away from a pulley, rope behind your head. Extend the arms forward and up, then return slowly.
exercises.safety_tips: Keep the core braced and elbows pointing forward.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions: Grip just outside shoulder width. Lean back slightly and pull the bar to the upper chest, leading with the elbows. Return under control.
exercises.safety_tips: Do not pull behind the neck. Avoid swinging the torso to move the weight.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-Up
exercises.instructions: Kneel or stand on the assist platform. Pull your chin over the bar with chest up, then lower fully.
exercises.safety_tips: More assistance = easier. Step off the platform carefully.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
exercises.instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench. Row dumbbells toward the hips, squeeze the shoulder blades, then lower fully.
exercises.safety_tips: Keep your chest on the pad so the lower back stays relaxed.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.instructions: Sit tall with a slight knee bend. Pull the handle to the lower ribs, squeeze the back, then let the arms extend without rounding.
exercises.safety_tips: Keep the torso mostly still; avoid rocking.

exercises.name: One-Arm Cable Row
exercises.instructions: Stand or kneel side-on to a low pulley. Row the handle to your hip, then reach forward to stretch. Repeat on the other side.
exercises.safety_tips: Brace the core so you do not twist through the lower back.

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck
exercises.instructions: Face the pad, grip the handles, and sweep the arms back in an arc until in line with the body. Return slowly.
exercises.safety_tips: Keep the chest on the pad and the motion smooth.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.instructions: Set a rope at upper-chest height. Pull toward your face, splitting the rope and turning thumbs back.
exercises.safety_tips: Light to moderate weight; this is a control exercise.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.instructions: Stand tall, elbows at your sides. Curl the dumbbells up, turning palms toward you, then lower fully.
exercises.safety_tips: Do not swing the hips. Lower under control.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.instructions: Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other. Curl up keeping that grip, then lower slowly.
exercises.safety_tips: Keep elbows close to the body.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.instructions: Kneel facing a high pulley with the rope by your head. Curl the ribs toward the hips, then return slowly.
exercises.safety_tips: Move from the spine, not by pulling with the arms.

exercises.name: Reverse Crunch
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent. Curl the hips up off the floor toward the chest, then lower under control.
exercises.safety_tips: Keep the movement slow; do not use momentum.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back, arms up, knees at 90°. Lower opposite arm and leg while keeping the lower back pressed down, return, switch.
exercises.safety_tips: If the lower back lifts, shorten the range.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
exercises.instructions: Hang from a bar or use a captain's chair. Bring the knees toward the chest by curling the pelvis, then lower slowly.
exercises.safety_tips: Avoid swinging. Use the reverse crunch if grip or shoulders limit you.

exercises.name: Squat
exercises.instructions: Bar on the upper back, feet shoulder width. Brace, sit down between your hips to a comfortable depth, then drive up.
exercises.safety_tips: Use safety pins in a rack. Keep knees tracking over toes. Start light while learning; goblet squat or leg press are good alternatives.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.instructions: Feet shoulder-width on the platform. Release the safety, lower until knees are around 90°, then press without locking the knees.
exercises.safety_tips: Keep your lower back on the pad. Re-engage the safety handles when finished.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Stand tall holding the bar. Push hips back with soft knees, sliding the bar down the thighs until you feel a hamstring stretch, then stand up.
exercises.safety_tips: Keep the back flat and bar close. Stop if you feel lower-back pain. Controlled reps only.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.instructions: Set the pad just above the heels. Curl the pad toward you, pause, and return slowly.
exercises.safety_tips: Keep hips down on the bench or seat.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.instructions: Align the knee with the machine pivot. Extend the legs, pause briefly, then lower slowly.
exercises.safety_tips: Avoid kicking the weight up. Reduce load if the knee feels irritated.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.instructions: Balls of feet on the edge of a step. Lower the heels for a stretch, then rise as high as possible and pause.
exercises.safety_tips: Hold onto support. Full range beats heavy bouncing.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
exercises.instructions: Sit with the pad on your lower thighs and the balls of your feet on the platform. Lower the heels, then press up and pause.
exercises.safety_tips: Move slowly through the full range.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.instructions: Upper back on a bench, bar padded across the hips. Drive through the heels to lift the hips until the body is flat, squeeze, lower.
exercises.safety_tips: Use a bar pad. Keep the chin tucked and ribs down. Glute bridge on the floor is an easier alternative.

exercises.name: Pec Deck Fly
exercises.instructions: Sit tall, arms on the pads or handles at chest height. Bring them together in front, squeeze, return slowly.
exercises.safety_tips: Stop the stretch at a comfortable range for your shoulders.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Fly
exercises.instructions: Lie flat, dumbbells above the chest, slight elbow bend. Open the arms wide in an arc, then bring them back together.
exercises.safety_tips: Use light weights; the stretch at the bottom is where shoulders are most at risk.

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder Press
exercises.instructions: Seat height so handles start at shoulder level. Press overhead without locking hard, lower under control.
exercises.safety_tips: Keep your back against the pad.

exercises.name: Cable Fly
exercises.instructions: Set pulleys around shoulder height. With a soft bend in the elbows, bring the handles together in front of the chest, then open slowly.
exercises.safety_tips: Keep the elbow angle fixed. Do not let the cables pull your shoulders behind your body.

exercises.name: Arnold Press
exercises.instructions: Start with dumbbells at chin height, palms facing you. Rotate palms forward as you press overhead, reverse on the way down.
exercises.safety_tips: Go lighter than a normal shoulder press.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.instructions: Stand side-on to a low pulley, handle in the far hand. Raise the arm out to shoulder height, lower slowly.
exercises.safety_tips: Light weight, no swinging.

exercises.name: Machine Lateral Raise
exercises.instructions: Pads against the outside of the arms. Raise to shoulder height, pause, lower slowly.
exercises.safety_tips: Keep shoulders down; do not shrug.

exercises.name: Straight-Bar Pushdown
exercises.instructions: High pulley with a straight or V bar. Elbows pinned to your sides, push down to full extension.
exercises.safety_tips: Only the forearms move.

exercises.name: Assisted Dip
exercises.instructions: On the assisted dip machine, lower until upper arms are about parallel to the floor, then press back up.
exercises.safety_tips: Skip if dips bother your shoulders. More assistance = easier.

exercises.name: Overhead Dumbbell Extension
exercises.instructions: Seated, hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands. Lower it behind your head by bending the elbows, then extend.
exercises.safety_tips: Keep elbows pointing up and the core braced.

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
exercises.instructions: Lie flat holding an EZ bar over the chest. Bend the elbows to lower the bar toward the forehead, then extend.
exercises.safety_tips: Use a light load and control the bottom position.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Pulldown
exercises.instructions: Use a V-handle. Lean back slightly and pull the handle to the upper chest, elbows down and back.
exercises.safety_tips: Avoid swinging the torso.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
exercises.instructions: Chest on the pad, grip the handles. Row toward the chest, squeeze the shoulder blades, lower fully.
exercises.safety_tips: Keep the chest on the pad.

exercises.name: Machine Row
exercises.instructions: Chest against the pad. Pull the handles back, squeeze, return slowly.
exercises.safety_tips: Adjust the seat so handles are at mid-chest.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.instructions: One knee and hand on a bench, back flat. Row the dumbbell toward your hip, lower fully. Repeat on the other side.
exercises.safety_tips: Keep the back flat and hips square.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Rear-Delt Fly
exercises.instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench. Raise light dumbbells out to the sides, lead with the elbows, lower slowly.
exercises.safety_tips: Very light weights; feel the back of the shoulders.

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Curl
exercises.instructions: Stand tall holding an EZ bar. Curl it up without moving the elbows forward, lower fully.
exercises.safety_tips: No hip swing.

exercises.name: Cable Curl
exercises.instructions: Low pulley with a bar or rope. Curl up keeping elbows at your sides, lower slowly.
exercises.safety_tips: Stand far enough back that the weight stack does not touch down between reps.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
exercises.instructions: Sit back on a bench set to about 60°, arms hanging. Curl up without bringing the elbows forward.
exercises.safety_tips: Lighter than standing curls.

exercises.name: Rope Hammer Curl
exercises.instructions: Low pulley with a rope, palms facing each other. Curl up, lower slowly.
exercises.safety_tips: Keep elbows close to your body.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl
exercises.instructions: Upper arms on the preacher pad. Curl up, lower almost to full extension under control.
exercises.safety_tips: Do not drop into the bottom position.

exercises.name: Machine Crunch
exercises.instructions: Sit in the ab crunch machine. Curl the ribs toward the hips, return slowly.
exercises.safety_tips: Move from the spine, not the arms.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.instructions: Lie on your side, elbow under shoulder. Lift the hips to form a straight line and hold. Log seconds as reps.
exercises.safety_tips: Drop to the knees to make it easier.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.instructions: Forearms under shoulders, body in a straight line. Hold. Log seconds as reps.
exercises.safety_tips: Drop to the knees if the lower back sags.

exercises.name: Pallof Press
exercises.instructions: Stand side-on to a chest-height pulley. Press the handle straight out and resist the twist, return.
exercises.safety_tips: Light weight; the challenge is staying still.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.instructions: Kneel holding the wheel. Roll forward as far as you can keep the back flat, then pull back.
exercises.safety_tips: Start with a short range.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Raise
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back, hands under hips. Raise straight legs to vertical, lower slowly without arching.
exercises.safety_tips: Bend the knees to make it easier.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
exercises.instructions: Shoulders under the pads, feet shoulder-width. Release the safety, lower to a comfortable depth, drive up.
exercises.safety_tips: Keep your back on the pad; re-engage the safeties at the end.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest. Sit down between your hips keeping the chest up, then stand.
exercises.safety_tips: Great for learning squat technique.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Hold dumbbells in front of the thighs. Push the hips back with soft knees until you feel a hamstring stretch, then stand.
exercises.safety_tips: Flat back; stop if the lower back aches.

exercises.name: 45° Back Extension
exercises.instructions: Hips on the pad. Lower the torso, then rise by squeezing the glutes until the body is straight.
exercises.safety_tips: Do not hyperextend at the top.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.instructions: Thigh pad snug, roller just above the heels. Curl down and back, pause, return slowly.
exercises.safety_tips: Keep hips against the seat.

exercises.name: Leg Press Calf Raise
exercises.instructions: On the leg press, balls of feet on the bottom edge of the platform. Push through the toes, lower for a stretch.
exercises.safety_tips: Keep the knees straight but not locked; never remove the safety.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back, feet flat. Drive the hips up, squeeze, lower. Add a weight on the hips when easy.
exercises.safety_tips: Ribs down; do not arch the back.

exercises.name: Cable Glute Kickback
exercises.instructions: Ankle strap on a low pulley. Kick the leg straight back, squeeze, return slowly.
exercises.safety_tips: Keep the torso still.

exercises.name: Split Squat
exercises.instructions: Take a long stance, one foot forward. Lower the back knee toward the floor, then push up through the front foot. Start with bodyweight.
exercises.safety_tips: Hold onto support for balance. Keep the front knee over the foot.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.instructions: Rear foot on a bench. Lower the back knee toward the floor, drive up through the front foot.
exercises.safety_tips: Hold support for balance; start with bodyweight.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.instructions: Step forward into a lunge, lower the back knee, push up and step through. Count each leg.
exercises.safety_tips: Take long steps; keep the front knee over the foot.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Step-Up
exercises.instructions: Step onto a knee-height box, drive up through that foot, step down with control.
exercises.safety_tips: Use a stable box; start light.
